context: Stocks ended September mixed as the S&P 500 slipped and Nasdaq edged higher, with Treasury yields surging and Micron's strong earnings report failing to lift shares after hours.

items.why: Jabil beat Q4 earnings but its fiscal 2027 outlook worried investors.
items.judge_note: h1 attributes retreat to fiscal 2027 outlook; h5 confirms Q4 beat and share drop.

items.why: Micron beat Q4 estimates and issued strong Q1 outlook on AI demand.
items.sentiment: Shares barely moved after hours despite the beat.
items.judge_note: h113 ties strong guidance to data center (AI) revenue jump; h114 confirms Q4 beat and strong Q1 outlook. h111/h118 both indicate stock barely budged.

items.why: Wells Fargo called AppLovin's Pixel install spike a false start.
items.sentiment: Shares fell to a fresh 52-week low.
items.judge_note: h21 directly quotes 'false start'; h160 says Wells Fargo 'flags pixel hype' implying same. Both h20 and h21 confirm fresh 52-week low.

items.why: Constellation signed a 20-year nuclear power deal with Amazon for 190 megawatts.
items.sentiment: Shares fell in the regular session, then rose overnight.
items.judge_note: Both headlines confirm 20-year Amazon nuclear PPA at 190 MW. h37 shows regular-session fall; h43 shows overnight rise.

items.why: The 10-year Treasury yield hit a 24-year high and Kashkari flagged another rate hike.
items.sentiment: Stocks ended mixed; S&P down, Nasdaq up.
items.judge_note: h212 confirms 24-year high in 10-year yield; h234 confirms Kashkari flagged another rate hike. h215 and h216 both show S&P down/Nasdaq up.

dropped.why: Hewlett Packard Enterprise raised its AI networking outlook and landed a $1.2 billion order.
dropped.sentiment: Shares jumped to a fresh record high.
drop: judge: Headlines mention 'raised revenue targets' and 'growing networking orders' plus $1.2B deal, but neither explicitly states an 'AI networking outlook' was raised.
